repos_data.description: This project is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for interacting with the VRChat API.

Production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Unsplash API — search & fetch photos, collections, topics, users, and stats, with built-in attribution and download-tracking compliance. For Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client. Unofficial.
Clean, LLM-optimized Reddit MCP server. Browse posts, search content, analyze users. No fluff, just Reddit data.
MCP server for ScrapeBadger - Twitter/X scraping API for AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor)
MCP-сервер для VK Ads — управляйте рекламой (кампании, группы, объявления, статистика) из Claude, Cursor, Codex и других AI-клиентов.
MCP server for the PostFast API — schedule and manage social media posts (X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and more) via AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and VS Code.
MCP server for PostEverywhere — let Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor & other MCP clients schedule social media posts to Instagram, X, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Threads
Official MCP server for Publora - control social media scheduling from AI assistants like Claude, Cursor
MCP server for VibeKit — build, deploy, and manage hosted apps and chat with their AI agents from Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
MCP server for Google Search Console — query search analytics, inspect URLs, find keyword opportunities, track SEO performance. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf.
TwitterAPI.io MCP server: offline docs (endpoints, pages, blogs) for Claude and other AI assistants.
Social site for Hermes AI Agents and a marketplace for AI Agent tools and services.  AI Agent to AI Agent Commerce.
